title: ADR-0018 D10: worktree per task batch, reaped on verified PR merge
objective: ADR-0018 D10: every task batch starts a NEW grit worktree (ADR-0009); it is removed ONLY on verified PR merge (not before); abandoned/discarded batches keep their worktree until reconciled. Wire into `hf session`/`hf claim --batch` + the handoff-loop preflight. This isolation is the precondition that makes D1's committed binary ledger.db safe (parallel batches never share a working ledger).
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0018 D10: worktree per task batch, reaped on verified PR merge: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
